mapper.select: select tenant_id, calendar_code, paused, paused_at, paused_by, pause_reason, updated_at from batch.batch_day_catchup_control where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and calendar_code = #{calendarCode} for update
mapper.insert: insert into batch.batch_day_catchup_control (tenant_id, calendar_code) values (#{tenantId}, #{calendarCode}) on conflict (tenant_id, calendar_code) do nothing
mapper.update: update batch.batch_day_catchup_control set paused = #{paused}, paused_at = #{pausedAt}, paused_by = #{pausedBy}, pause_reason = #{pauseReason}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and calendar_code = #{calendarCode}
mapper.insert: insert into batch.batch_day_catchup_control_event (tenant_id, calendar_code, action, operator_id, reason, occurred_at) values (#{tenantId}, #{calendarCode}, #{action}, #{operatorId}, #{reason}, #{occurredAt})
